## Skill (existing) or New Skill?

- [ ] Improvement to existing skill (which one): 
- [ ] New skill (proposed name): 

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who has this problem? How often?

## Proposed Solution

What should the skill do? What's the API / command surface?

## Alternatives Considered

What else did you think about? Why isn't it good enough?

## Trigger Conditions

When should an agent activate this skill? Be specific — this becomes the SKILL.md description.

## Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a PR
- [ ] I'd like to discuss first
- [ ] Just an idea — anyone can pick it up
